youtube.caption:
Julius Caesar was stabbed 23 times. The doctor said only ONE of them mattered 💀

Worst group project you've been in? Drop it 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: Suetonius writes that Caesar was stabbed 23 times on the Ides of March, 44 BC, by a plot of more than sixty conspirators, and that the physician Antistius found only one wound fatal, the second, in the chest. It's often called the first recorded autopsy.
